rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for making an audio or video recording, including recording something or making a recording generally.

example.english: I'll record what you're saying on my phone.
example.traditional: 我用手機錄低你講嘅嘢。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 sau2 gei1 luk6 dai1 nei5 gong2 ge3 je5

rows.note: Use this when recording information means writing it down or making a note for later reference.

example.english: Tell me the address and I'll record it for later.
example.jyutping: nei5 gong2 go3 dei6 zi2 ngo5 gei3 dai1 sin1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday noun for stored information or a person’s data file.

example.jyutping: ngo5 wan2 m4 dou2 nei5 fan6 gei3 luk6

rows.note: Use this for an official or historical record, and especially for a best achievement or extreme value.

example.english: No one has broken this record yet.
example.traditional: 呢項紀錄到而家仲未有人打破。
example.jyutping: ni1 hong6 gei2 luk6 dou3 ji4 gaa1 zung6 mei6 jau5 jan4 daa2 po3

rows.note: Use this for a music record or release when the physical format is not important.

example.english: Their new record sounds pretty good.
example.traditional: 佢新出嗰隻唱片幾好聽。
example.jyutping: keoi5 san1 ceot1 go2 zek3 coeng3 pin2 gei2 hou2 teng1

rows.note: Use this specifically for a vinyl record rather than a digital or unspecified music release.

example.english: I bought a vinyl record at the record shop.
example.traditional: 我喺唱片舖買咗張黑膠唱片。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 coeng3 pin2 pou3 maai5 zo2 zoeng1 hak1 gaau1 coeng3 pin2
